attention2.ptxt: Touching a hot exhaust system component will cause a burn.
Do not perform any service work on the exhaust system until the exhaust system is cool.

attention4.ptxt: The turbocharger will lose its original performance if it is disassembled.
If any faulty condition is found, replace the turbocharger with a new one.

s1.ptxt: Drain coolant.
Remove catalytic converter with GPF.
Remove turbocharger cover (1).
Disconnect waste gate control hose No.2 (1).
Remove turbocharger outlet air pipe bracket (2).
Remove turbocharger water outlet pipe (3) and turbocharger water inlet pipe (4).
Disconnect ABV connector from turbocharger.
Remove turbocharger outlet air pipe (1) and air cleaner outlet hose (2).
Remove turbocharger oil intake pipe (1) with oil intake pipe union bolt No.1 (2) and No.2 (3) and gaskets.
Disconnect oil drain joint (1) and oil drain hose.
Remove turbocharger (1) with air cleaner outlet pipe and gasket.
Remove air cleaner outlet pipe (1) from turbocharger.
Disconnect oil drain joint (1) from turbocharger oil drain hose (2), if necessary.
Remove turbocharger oil drain hose from cylinder block, if necessary.
Check mating surface of removed turbocharger for rust and, if rusted, remove the rust.
Install turbocharger oil drain joint (1) and new oil drain hose (2), if removed.
Install air cleaner outlet pipe (1) to turbocharger.
Install turbocharger (1) with new gasket, and then tighten turbocharger bolts (2) and nuts (3) to specified torque.
Install oil drain joint (1) with new oil drain joint gasket (2) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Fit claws on gasket to oil drain joint flange.
Tighten oil drain joint bolts (3) to specified torque.

s1.ptxt: Check mesh filter in oil intake pipe union bolt No.1 for cleanliness.
Install turbocharger oil intake pipe (1) with new gaskets as follows.

s2.ptxt: Tighten turbocharger oil intake pipe union bolt No.1 (2) and No.2 (3) temporarily by hand in numerical order (“1” – “2”).
Tighten them to specified torque in the same manner as in Step a).

torqueitem.t-part: Turbocharger oil intake pipe union bolt No.1
Turbocharger oil intake pipe union bolt No.2

s1.ptxt: Install turbocharger outlet air pipe (1) and air cleaner outlet hose (2).
Connect ABV connector to turbocharger.
Install turbocharger water outlet pipe (1) with new gaskets, and then tighten turbocharger water outlet pipe union bolt (2) to specified torque.
Install turbocharger water inlet pipe (3) with new gaskets, and then tighten turbocharger water inlet pipe union bolt (4) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Turbocharger water outlet pipe union bolt
Turbocharger water inlet pipe union bolt

s1.ptxt: Install turbocharger outlet air pipe bracket (1).
Connect waste gate control hose No.2 (2).
Install turbocharger cover (1).
Install catalytic converter with GPF.
Refill cooling system with coolant.
Check cooling system for leakage.
